observations: Single photo shows a hand holding a black handheld torch/spotlight with a large reflector lens and a top carry handle.
Side of unit has a small panel with buttons and what looks like a charging port or indicator light.
Watermarks read 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'LUMETT SOLAR ENERGY NIG.' - these are platform/seller watermarks, not a brand plate on the item itself.
No visible model number, wattage, or lumen rating printed on the torch body in the photo.
No photo of the unit powered on, charging, or showing battery compartment.

identity.kind: rechargeable LED torch light / handheld spotlight

claims.claim: DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a torch of this general shape, but 'DP' brand is not legible anywhere on the item itself; only a reseller watermark is visible.
No photo of charging port in use, charger cable, or indicator light lit.
This is a marketing/use-case claim, not a checkable physical fact from any photo.
Photo 0 shows the lens/reflector but the unit is not shown switched on or emitting light.

risks.risk: Torch may not power on or hold charge (dead/weak battery is common in used rechargeable torches).
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the torch switched on and illuminated in a dim room.

risks.risk: Actual brightness/lumens may be far lower than implied by the large reflector size.
risks.proof: A lit photo at a measured distance, or a close-up of any printed spec/label on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unverified output, not as a high-lumen unit

risks.risk: Physical condition (cracks, loose handle, dented reflector rim) not fully visible from one angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, back, and both sides, plus a close-up of the lens and handle hinge.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume wear

risks.proof: A photo of the torch together with its charger/cable.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

proof_requests: A video or photo of the torch switched on and lit in a dark/dim setting.
A close-up of any brand/model label or sticker on the torch body.
A photo of the charging port in use or the included charger/cable.
Additional angles (front-on, back, both sides) to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a handheld rechargeable LED torch, but none of the seller's functional claims (rechargeable, working LED, brand) are shown proven in the single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-functional unit pending the requested proof.
